id: title:dmarchuk:sweep conversion watchers in the janitor and raise the default window

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a cleanup sweep for expired conversion watchers to the CyclotronV2Janitor, potentially preventing unbounded growth of the conversion_watchers table.
review.reason: The chunk removes an old watcher sweep and adds a new one to CyclotronV2Janitor, which cleans up terminal jobs. This could help prevent the conversion_watchers table from growing unbounded.
